definitions.aligned: Requirement status PASS — applicable check succeeded with evidence.
definitions.deviated: Requirement status FAIL, WARN, INDETERMINATE, EVIDENCE_MISSING, ERROR, REVIEW_REQUIRED, or UNSUPPORTED.
definitions.excluded: Requirement status NOT_APPLICABLE (or empty) — out of flag-rate denominator.
definitions.flag_rate: deviated / assessed = (FAIL + other deviate statuses) / assessed. Wilson 95% CI when assessed > 0.
